author: Hank Green
description:
Moderna and Merck announced that they have completed a Phase 3 trial for a vaccine that significantly improves outcomes for people with melanoma (the most deadly form of skin cancer.)

This is very exciting...but /how/ exciting is it? And could it mean not just a new cancer therapy but a whole new /class/ of cancer therapies? I think it could very well be both.
